label: Synthetic repository-authored diagnostic expansion; not an external benchmark, held-out sample, or independently human-labeled dataset
authorship: This expansion was separately authored from a distinct intent inventory while reading the same two fixed educational guides. Authoring had access to v1 context; conceptual overlap with v1 is expected, so it is not a held-out generalization test. Query set and initial labels frozen before running v2 retrieval. No production retrieval tuning.
gold_policy: Binary chunk relevance: a labeled chunk must directly support an explicit requested proposition, including relevant alternatives and supporting parts of a multi-part request. Examples and summaries count only when they provide the requested evidence; heading/contents-only mentions do not. Exact excerpts demonstrate source presence, not semantic annotation correctness. Recall is fraction of labeled relevant chunks, not answer-component coverage. Unlisted chunks count as nonrelevant and omissions remain possible.
scope: Retrieval within bundled documents. Statements qualify what those educational documents say; they do not validate current provider APIs, healthcare safety, live patient data, runtime security, generated answers, or production reliability. Ambiguous cases explicitly qualify the implementation, table, example or section.
